x_input, y_input, max_b = map(int, input().split())
min_difference = float('inf')
result_b, result_a = 0, 0

def try_update(b_value, a_value):
    global min_difference, result_b, result_a
    diff = abs((a_value / b_value) - (x_input / y_input))
    if diff + 1e-15 < min_difference:
        min_difference = diff
        result_b, result_a = b_value, a_value

for b in range(1, max_b + 1):
    a_floor = (x_input * b) // y_input
    a_ceil = a_floor + 1
    try_update(b, a_floor)
    try_update(b, a_ceil)

print(f"{result_a}/{result_b}")
</translated_code>
